about: The company's own warehouse and showroom addresses, from the official site https://houzscentury.com/ (fetched 2026-11-17; owner confirmed they are public). Read by scripts/fill-master-postcodes.mjs: a scm.warehouses row matches when its name OR its code equals one of `names` ignoring case (`names` lists both warehouse names and warehouse codes); a row whose name and code point at different entries is refused. The street is written into an empty `location` only; City/State are written from scm.my_localities for the postcode. Not listed on purpose: GUANGZHOU WAREHOUSE, Consignment (Out), CASH & CARRY SEGMENT - FAIR (no fixed address), and code EM DISPLAY (not known which site it is; the SARAWAK DISPLAY name still matches).
